title: Atlanticus Announces Approval of Quarterly Preferred Stock Dividend
description: Atlanticus Holdings Corporation announced a quarterly dividend of $0.476563 per share to its Series B Cumulative Perpetual Preferred shareholders, payable on September 15, 2024 to holders of record on September 1, 2024.

title: Atlanticus Reports Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results
description: Atlanticus Holdings Corporation reported strong financial results for the third quarter of 2024, with a 19.0% increase in total operating revenue and a 22.9% increase in net income attributable to common shareholders. The company continues to see growth in its managed receivables and total accounts served.

title: Atlanticus Announces Approval of Quarterly Preferred Stock Dividend
description: Atlanticus Holdings Corporation announced that its Board of Directors approved a quarterly dividend of $0.476563 per share to Series B Cumulative Perpetual Preferred shareholders, to be paid on or about December 16, 2024.
